passages.text:
<line> I think you know by now...
<line> You've failed the inspection.
[[((i did this to us))]]
[[((the manager did this to us))->managerShoot]]
[[((the manager did this to us))->managerSpare]]

passages.name: Start

passages.text:
<line> As the roaches are to you, you are a pest to me.
<line> You all are. The Manager. Your Emily. You.
<line> Living on my property.
<line> Getting it dirty. Messing it up.
<line> Oohhhh, my beautiful investments!!!
[[((so does he or does he not want roaches everywhere...??))]]

links.name: ((so does he or does he not want roaches everywhere...??))
links.link: ((so does he or does he not want roaches everywhere...??))

passages.name: second

passages.text:
<line> I know.
<line> There were roaches and mold in my apartment. And now you're coming for your payback or whatever.
<line> It doesn't matter anymore whose responsibility it was. This is beyond insane, and you can't take my home and family from me.
[[((i am actually shaking right now though))]]

links.name: ((i am actually shaking right now though))
links.link: ((i am actually shaking right now though))

passages.name: ((i did this to us))

passages.text:
<line> Yes. You see now.
<line> And you intend to stop me with what?
<line> Interesting you believe paperwork has any say here, in my domain.
[[((...))->second]]
passages.name: ((i am actually shaking right now though))

passages.text:
<clue> ShootManager
<line> This isn't our fault!
<line> The manager refused to send pest control.
<line> I know she was conspiring with you!
<line> She's dead, and you're next!!
[[((this thing is SCARY as FUCK))->shootManagerResponse]]
passages.name: managerShoot

passages.text:
<clue> SpareManager
<line> This isn't our fault!
<line> The manager refused to send pest control. Or... they didn't come.
<line> And then the mold came out of nowhere!
<line> I've been doing nothing but killing roaches and cleaning for the past two days!
<line> You can't punish Emily and I for this! I'll sue!
[[((what the hell is this place...))]]
passages.name: managerSpare

passages.text:
<clue> ShootManager
<line> You always knew we were going to fail!
<line> You planted the mold and the roaches!
<line> That must have been what the manager was rambling about... you're setting the tenants up to fail so you can screw us all over!
<line> She's dead now- and you will be soon!!
[[((FUCK... THIS GUY IS CREEPY!!!))->shootManagerResponse]]
passages.name: roachlordShoot

passages.text:
<clue> SpareManager
<line> You always knew we were going to fail!
<line> You planted the mold and the roaches!
<line> You possessed the manager and made it impossible for us to succeed!!
[[((FUCK... THIS GUY IS CREEPY!!!))]]
passages.name: roachlordSpare

passages.text:
<line> The Manager and I had a deal.
<line> I find her presence here now rather disappointing. This will show up on her Review. It is not in the Company spirit.
<line> And you.
[[(...)->second]]
passages.name: ((FUCK... THIS GUY IS CREEPY!!!))

passages.text:
<line> Ah, you think your manager was behind this.
<line> You think you can clean her up like you did your roaches.
<line> But like your roaches, a thousand more Managers are hatching for every one you squash.
<line> You think this situation is unique to your Manager and your building.
[[((...))->second]]
passages.name: shootManagerResponse

passages.text:
<line> You bring her here, and still blame her.
<line> So disappointing... she will be put on a Performance Improvement Plan.
<line> I'm sure you understand, since you are convinced of her incompetence. I am inclined to agree.
<line> But you.
[[((...))->second]]
passages.name: ((what the hell is this place...))

passages.text:
<line> If you don't want the property covered in roaches and mold, why not help us keep it clean??
<line> Why does it seem like you want us to fail the inspection???
[[((maybe there is no sense in this world))]]

links.link: ((maybe there is no sense in this world))

passages.name: ((so does he or does he not want roaches everywhere...??))

passages.text: EndSeq12.2 Because. I do want you to fail. You leave. I relist. I raise the rent. I get a new tenant. They disappoint. They leave. I raise the rent... Why would I invest in a parasite like you? You act as if I invented the roach, or left your trash bag at the front door... never swept behind the fridge... invited them in. You disgusting... renters. You will never know beauty. How can you, if you've never tasted profit? There's one more matter to address.
passages.name: ((maybe there is no sense in this world))
